verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents adding SAFEs directly to the cap table and built-in e-signing, with the Premium plan explicitly listing "E-signing certificates & SAFE agreements." Note conversion appears only as a support article title about converting notes by the price-per-share method in a spreadsheet, so modeling of conversion terms is thinly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented modeling of SAFE/note conversion terms (valuation caps, discounts, MFN) on the cap table; explicit create-and-send workflow for convertible notes; e-signing is gated to Premium; no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create, send, and e-sign SAFEs or convertible notes in-platform, and they land on the cap table with their conversion terms modeled

citations.quote: add SAFEs directly to your cap table when you are ready to raise
Built-in e-signing keeps equity agreements organized and moving without relying on separate tools.
